full_page.content:
1933, November 4
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
(to Mr. Patrick Casey)
Mr. P.H.Casey McDamon's Post Dease Lake British Col. Canada
November 4
God Bless You Dear Brother:
I hope you are keeping contented. I've been reading of the missions up that way lately and it sure is interesting. Niece Mary was in a few days ago. is well as are seemingly all in the west - and Fr. Maurice. Ed. Sampson sends best regards.
Please pardon brevity - stolen time. Sincerely in Sacred Heart your Brother B.F. Fr. Solanus O.M.C.
